tips.text: “Standing order 14: the Third Legion holds the Wickham road until relieved.”
tips.source: Found in the Old Barrows · they are still holding it

tips.text: The Grey Sisters record every flare-seam in the Reach. Nobody has asked them why.
Reading Lord Pellam’s letter. All of it…
Solmere roads were laid for marching dead. They still run straight through anything in the way.
Maudry Fenn will tell you more than she should. Buy something first.
Telling the Third Legion it can stand down…
